--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,16 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```bash
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with `pytest path/to/test_file.py` or
+`pytest path/to/test_file.py::test_name`.
+
+Note: this repo does not contain any tests yet, so `pytest` currently reports
+zero collected tests. Add `test_*.py` files alongside the modules they cover.
